blog.title: PayChaser: chase late invoices without the awkwardness
blog.description: Track open invoices and get a three-stage chaser email — nudge, reminder, final notice — ready to copy and send.

body.text: Chasing late invoices is one of the worst parts of freelancing. The invoice sits unpaid, every week you tell yourself you'll send a reminder tomorrow, and the client stays silent. PayChaser takes the awkwardness out of it.

Add your open invoices with the client name, amount, and due date. PayChaser tracks how many days overdue each one is and drafts a three-stage email sequence for any invoice: a friendly nudge, a firm reminder, and a final notice. Copy the draft, paste it into your email, done.

Most late payments aren't malice — they're forgetfulness. Stage one assumes the best and gives the client an easy out. Stage two names the number of days and asks for a payment date. Stage three sets a hard deadline with consequences. Escalating politely gets you paid faster than one angry email.

items: Add each open invoice with client, amount, and due date
Open an invoice to see your days-overdue count
Pick the stage that matches how late it is
Copy the draft, tweak the tone if you like, and send

body.text: PayChaser is $12 a month, or $60 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
